dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: A single, high-contrast, thin white wing bar is visible across the greater coverts, showing clear demarcation against the dark wing feathers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High visibility of sharp, pale blueish-white edges on the folded primaries and secondaries against a darker background.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Distinct white patch on the nape with a roughly oval footprint, providing high contrast against the black crown and greenish mantle.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp, horizontal linear boundary exists between the black crown and the greenish mantle, with the white nape patch situated on this boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible bright yellow plumage on the lateral underparts and a prominent white cheek patch bordered by black.
